fields.label: Enable Batch Feedback Delivery
fields.description: On: feedback is saved immediately but the Glific feedback flow is started only by the scheduled runs (3pm, 4:30pm, and 9pm IST). Off: the consumer starts the flow immediately, as before.

fields.label: Glific Calls Per Second
fields.description: Applies to every Glific call (contact lookups and flow starts).

fields.label: Treat Running Run As Stale After (hours)
fields.description: A run still marked Running for longer than this no longer blocks a new run.

fields.label: Max Delivery Attempts
fields.description: After this many failed attempts a submission is parked for manual replay.

fields.label: Claim Lease (minutes)
fields.description: A claim older than this is treated as abandoned and can be taken again.

fields.label: Max Submission Age (days)
fields.description: Submissions older than this are never sent by the batch.
